title: Claim, citation and quote grounding check
description: Check whether a summary, citation, quote or changelog bullet is supported by its source text

claim.description: the bullet, citation claim, quote or summary

source.description: the source text: it must contain the relevant passage

claim_label.description: e.g. 'CHANGELOG BULLET', 'CLAIM IN DRAFT', 'QUOTE TO CHECK', 'SUMMARY TO CHECK'

source_name.description: optional, shown after the source label, e.g. 'src/http/client.py'

profile.description: the mode: strict = support (supports, contradicts, says_nothing), grounded (summary), quote (verbatim), overstatement

v.instructions: Judging only from the {{source_label}}, does it support, contradict, or say nothing about the {{claim_label}}?

criteria.supports: the source text states or clearly entails the claim
criteria.contradicts: the source text states something that conflicts with the claim
criteria.says_nothing: the source text does not address the claim at all

grounded.instructions: Is every factual statement in the {{claim_label}} supported by the {{source_label}}? Consider numbers, causes and durations.

criteria.true: all statements are supported by the source
criteria.false: at least one statement is unsupported or contradicts the source

verbatim.instructions: Ignoring line breaks, extra spaces and markdown formatting marks, does the {{source_label}} contain the {{claim_label}} word for word, with no changed, added or dropped words or numbers?

criteria.true: the same words in the same order appear in the excerpt
criteria.false: the quote differs from the excerpt in at least one word, number or method name

strength.instructions: Is the {{claim_label}} fully supported by the {{source_label}}, without any stronger wording than the source uses?

criteria.true: the source states this with the same strength
criteria.false: the claim is stronger than the source or unsupported

combine: supported if v == 'supports' and v.p >= support_p; contradicted if v == 'contradicts' and v.p >= contra_p; unsupported if v == 'says_nothing' and v.p >= nothing_p; supported if grounded >= pass_at; unsupported if grounded <= block_at; supported if strength >= pass_at; unsupported if strength <= block_at; supported if verbatim >= verbatim_ok; contradicted if verbatim <= verbatim_fab; review otherwise
limitations: the relevant passage must be in state (else says_nothing is a retrieval failure)
does not verify that URLs or DOIs exist
the substring and number checks that should run before any read are the caller's code
screen mode (inclusion and exclusion criteria) is not built
several bullets of one diff are a filter job
notes: # deviation: spec 5.16: the mode is the `profile` input; claim_label and source_label are required (the engine applies no schema defaults) and source_name completes the state line; a fabricated quote (verbatim <= 0.1) is contradicted and a grounded or overstatement score <= 0.3 is unsupported; the screen mode is not built
